description: Create 1 to 20 tasks in a project. Give each task its text as content, a contentType (text/markdown or text/plain) and a placement. To add a task at the top or bottom of the project, leave out taskId and use afterbegin or beforeend. To add it next to or inside a task, give that taskId with beforebegin, afterend, afterbegin or beforeend. Returns the id of each new task.

projectId.description: The project to create tasks in

tasks.description: Tasks to create, positioned relative to an existing task or the project root

name: createTask
title: Create Tasks
